best_for: Twitch viewers and moderators who keep several chats open at once and want 7TV, BTTV and FFZ emotes without running a browser tab.

points.title: Many chats, one window
points.text: Splits put several channels side by side in one tab, and you can join as many channels as you like. `/mentions` gathers every mention of you into one panel.

points.title: Third-party emotes built in
points.text: Twitch, BetterTTV, FrankerFaceZ and 7TV emotes show without extensions.

points.title: Highlights and Streamer Mode
points.text: You can highlight or ignore messages by your own rules and get notified on mentions. Streamer Mode hides user content while OBS is running.

points.title: Link previews are off by default
points.text: Previews of image links, YouTube stats and emotes are disabled out of the box for privacy. You can switch them on.

points.title: Free and open source
points.text: Chatterino is MIT licensed with no paid tier. It is a native app rather than a web wrapper, meant to stay light on CPU and GPU.

points.title: Install notes
points.text: Windows installs per user or for all users, and the listing keeps 7 versions. The Mac build is universal for macOS 12 and later. The Linux Flatpak is verified on Flathub but sits at 2.5.5, one release behind. macOS and Linux list only the current release.
